text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- 16 joint projects between Egypt and Malaysia discussed during the visit of Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri. In Singapore, the Egyptian delegation will focus on finalising agreements to protect and encourage investments.
- Supply and Trade Minister Ahmed Gueily said lifting of the ban on importing textiles will take place in the beginning of next year.
- Finance Minister Mohieddin al-Gharib says there is no intention at this time to decrease customs on imported cars.
- Foreign Minister Amr Moussa says in Malta that Egypt is seeking a balanced association agreement with Europe.
- Ganzouri says that there are plans to hold talks about setting up air links for direct flights between Malta and Egypt.
